Title: Developer Chat Tuesday, May 18, at 6pm EDT

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
White Wolf will be hosting an hour-long developer chat with Steve
Wieck and myself on Tuesday, May 18, at 6pm EDT (EDT = GMT-0400, so
that's 2200 GMT).

We'll talk about (among other things) Gehenna, the upcoming 10th
anniversary of V:TES, the next storyline series, and the TBA expansion
scheduled for February 2005.

Login point will be
http://chat1.white-wolf.com/DeveloperChat.html

Hope to see you there.

--
LSJ (vte...@white-wolf.com) V:TES Net.Rep for White Wolf, Inc.
Links to V:TES news, rules, cards, utilities, and tournament calendar:
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/
